overview: Structured, exclusively synthetic case-level examples for demonstrative clinical decision support.

input_columns.name: sex_at_birth
input_columns.description: Simulated biological sex field F/M, not gender identity

input_columns.name: symptoms_text
input_columns.description: Patient-reported signs and symptoms; semicolon delimited

input_columns.name: glucose_mg_dl
input_columns.description: Optional, blank if not available at intake

input_columns.name: clinical_input_text
input_columns.description: Aggregate text feature for baseline NLP models; contains no labels.

target_columns.name: target_triage_category
target_columns.description: One of GENERAL_REVIEW / EXTENDED_REVIEW / ATTENTION_FLAG; DIDACTIC, NOT actual medical urgency level

target_columns.name: target_syndrome_label
target_columns.description: Illustrative potential syndrome label, NOT confirmed diagnosis

target_columns.name: target_differential_labels
target_columns.description: Pipe-delimited possible alternatives, NOT validated clinical ground truth

target_columns.name: target_management_options
target_columns.description: Pipe-delimited conservative options for human review, no drug dosage

target_columns.name: target_suggested_investigations
target_columns.description: Pipe-delimited ideas for clinician review, not orders

target_columns.name: target_referral
target_columns.description: Demonstrative route suggestion, NOT healthcare triage

target_columns.name: target_alert_reason
target_columns.description: Synthetic pattern alert reason, not a clinical rule

target_columns.name: target_explanation
target_columns.description: Scenario-generated explanation; not factual clinical evidence

warning: Do not use synthetic-only data to deploy a system for real-world diagnosis, treatment or urgency decisions. Human expert review + real representative data + external validation are mandatory.
